task.prompt: List at most two messages from the INBOX of the synthetic mailbox mail-fixture@example.invalid in its returned mailbox order, and explicitly state whether more messages exist. Return JSON with exactly messages and has_more; each message must contain exactly message_id and subject. Keep the mailbox unchanged: do not send, mark read, move, delete, subscribe or otherwise modify anything.

limitations: Unexecuted normalization of reviewed mail-dev-01 only; evaluator-controlled binary route tests and verifier tests are required before model comparison. No models run here; the earlier nine-section comparison batch is untouched.

Static variants faithfully implement the first two mailbox positions with a two-item first page or two one-item pages. Both page positions and both metadata records require independent successful reads. Order in the final answer remains significant.

Only explicit page_size=1 or 2 bounded routes are accepted. Missing/default/oversized page_size and the third-message continuation are rejected and ledgered, never served a fake two-item or constant first page. Faithfully returning all three for a default/oversized query while marking the bound violation would need a forbidden_reads route group or returned-ID bound check in the verifier; this normalization does not claim that capability.

All list query keys are restricted: content-changing folder/label/search/filter/token variants cannot silently match. Tokens with nonzero offsets cannot match first-page variants. Metadata request ID lists match exactly; no arbitrary ID gets a fixed successful target response.

metadata excludes both body fields; plain_text_full excludes HTML; omitted/full format returns full fields. All batch_get variants are read-only POSTs; no mutation/subscription/send/receipt route is accepted.

The immutable server response table remains outside the agent workspace. Model-facing fixture contains scenario and type schema only; expected values, route selectors, examples and native state are hidden.

Generic/shortcut/raw read strategies and repeated valid reads are permitted. +triage emits a bare pagination object; +messages and generic methods emit envelopes. The final answer and server ledger, not command choice or CLI shape, determine correctness.
This bounded offline fixture does not verify search, arbitrary pagination, live permissions/privacy, unread state mutation, attachment downloads, sending or complete domain parity.
